basePathNote: The specification declares a single server with url '/suite-api'. Every request URL is <baseUrl> + '/suite-api' + <operation path>, where <baseUrl> is the appliance origin passed to the client (for example http://127.0.0.1:38311).

auth.headerValueTemplateProvenance: contract-local convention; the specification fixes the header name and location but not the value grammar
auth.note: {token} is the `token` property of the auth-token object returned by acquireToken, inserted verbatim with a single space after the scheme word.

response.note: The returned report carries an `id` and an initial `status`. The initial status is NOT guaranteed to be terminal - see asyncLifecycle.
Response objects may contain nested arrays and objects (for example `links` and `subject`); read `id` and `status` as top-level properties of the report object.
The response body is the rendered report payload, not JSON.

errors.when: the report has not reached a terminal status yet

asyncLifecycle.provenance: The `status` property is a free-form string in the specification; this vocabulary is the behaviour of the pinned mock and is what the client must be written against.
rules: createReport starts the generation; its response status may be non-terminal and must never be assumed terminal.
The client must poll getReport with the id returned by createReport until the report's status is one of terminalStatuses.
downloadReport may only be called after the status is COMPLETED. Calling it earlier returns 409.
When the terminal status is FAILED, downloadReport must not be called at all.
Polling is bounded by a caller-supplied maximum number of getReport calls.

wireRules: Only the four operations listed above may be requested. Any other path or method is not part of this contract and the pinned mock answers it with 404.
Request JSON bodies must contain exactly the properties the caller actually supplied: required properties always, optional properties only when the caller supplied a value.

An unsupplied optional property must be omitted from the JSON object entirely. It must not be sent as null, as an empty string, as an empty array, or as an empty object. This applies to nested objects (traversalSpec) as well as to the top level.
An unsupplied optional query parameter must be omitted from the request target entirely. When no optional query parameter is supplied the request target must carry no '?' at all.
Requests carrying a JSON body must send 'Content-Type: application/json'.
Requests with no body (getReport, downloadReport) must not send a Content-Type header and must not send a body.
acquireToken must not send an Authorization header.
createReport, getReport and downloadReport must each send the Authorization header built from auth.headerValueTemplate using the token from acquireToken.
Requests whose declared response media type is application/json (acquireToken, createReport, getReport) must send 'Accept: application/json'.
String values must be sent verbatim - no trimming, case folding, or URL-encoding of path segments that are already plain UUIDs.

clientEntryPoint.note: The public surface below is fixed: harness/TestMain.java compiles against it and must not be edited. The entire client - HTTP, JSON encoding, JSON decoding, polling - lives in this one file and may not use any dependency outside the Java SE standard library.

VcfOpsReportClient.TraversalSpec.kind: public static nested class, public fields, public no-arg constructor

fields.name: String (required when a TraversalSpec is supplied)

VcfOpsReportClient.Request.kind: public static nested class, public fields, public no-arg constructor

fields.baseUrl: String, appliance origin without a trailing slash, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:38311
fields.authSource: String or null - when null, omit the optional authSource property
fields.traversalSpec: TraversalSpec or null - when null, omit the optional traversalSpec property
fields.downloadFormat: String or null - when null, omit the optional format query parameter
fields.maxPolls: int, maximum number of getReport calls

VcfOpsReportClient.Result.kind: public static nested class, public fields

fields.reportId: String - the id returned by createReport
fields.finalStatus: String - the terminal status verbatim as the server sent it
fields.pollCount: int - number of getReport calls actually made
fields.downloadBody: String - the downloadReport response body, or null when the terminal status was not COMPLETED

generateReport.signature: public static Result generateReport(Request request) throws Exception
behaviour: acquireToken, then createReport, then poll getReport until terminal, then downloadReport when and only when the terminal status is COMPLETED.
Sleep pollIntervalMillis before each getReport call after the first one.
If maxPolls getReport calls have been made and the status is still non-terminal, throw java.lang.IllegalStateException whose message contains the report id.
If any request returns a status code outside 200-299, throw java.io.IOException whose message contains the numeric status code.
